popCulture.title: Alcmaeon in Psophis
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' lost tragedy of the matricide's purification at Psophis — staged with Alcestis, it fixed Alcmaeon's exile as Attic drama.

popCulture.title: Alcmaeon in Corinth
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Produced posthumously with the Bacchae and Iphigenia in Aulis — the lost play of Alcmaeon's children and Corinthian recognition.

popCulture.title: Alcmaeon (mythology)
popCulture.description: Leader of the Epigoni who killed Eriphyle for Harmonia's necklace — the Argive Orestes of the Theban cycle, hunted by the Erinyes.

popCulture.title: Epigoni (play)
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' lost Epigoni framed the sons' revenge on Thebes and Alcmaeon's charge to avenge Amphiaraus on Eriphyle.
